python_test_count_note: These are execution counts in separate receipts; their sum is not a count of distinct tests.

harness_repairs.scope: Historical epoch, knowledge, and category assertions only; original proof commands and semantic sources unchanged.

certificate_limit: Certifies the published Pass74 semantic commit using the original FULL receipt and the complete successful targeted rerun of its three failed historical categories. It does not certify future semantic changes.
timing_scope: Arithmetic sum of separately measured original FULL and targeted rerun execution times; repair time excluded.
